purpose: Publish the current deterministic-eligible Steam KZ deal catalogue continuously while GitHub-owned item-level PASS 1 progressively resolves current semantic fit and a separately implemented future PASS 2 may recover only dossier-ready incomplete items without waiting for global PASS 1 completion.

state_projection.analyzed_fit: exact-compatible trustworthy accepted INCLUDE with fit strong or moderate and the selected existing business scenario still INCLUDE
state_projection.analyzed_not_fit: exact-compatible trustworthy completed semantic EXCLUDE where current fit-evidence semantics establish a completed not-fit rather than missing evidence
state_projection.analysis_incomplete: only when current canonical evidence proves an attempt/outcome is incomplete without trustworthy fit/not-fit
state_projection.not_analyzed: default for no trustworthy current semantic outcome, including stale/incompatible results
state_projection.insufficient_information_rule: missing or insufficient candidate evidence is unresolved and must not be hidden as analyzed_not_fit
state_projection.stale_or_incompatible_rule: never present stale or incompatible Taste as current fit/not-fit
state_projection.pass1_current_exact_result: current exact-bound PASS 1 outcome may project analyzed_fit, analyzed_not_fit, or analysis_incomplete without mutating the canonical V5 Taste cache

sorting.tier_2_3: producer-owned deterministic purchase-only score from the existing purchase component semantics; never total_score

phase_c_pass2_design.purpose: One bounded automatic recovery attempt for a current analysis_incomplete item only after GitHub can prove a current exact-compatible canonically accepted Taste Steam Review Dossier for the same item/work identity.

conditions: a dossier exists in the canonical GitHub-owned dossier store and was persisted by canonical dossier ingest/validation rather than merely buffered or worker-produced
when the current item exposes a release year, dossier.game_identity.release_year == current_item.release_year
dossier identity is resolved under the current Dossier identity rules with cross-release combination forbidden
dossier.web_evidence_contract_binding exactly equals the current active content-complete Dossier compatibility binding required by the canonical Dossier schema/evidence/prompt contracts
dossier is fresh at eligibility evaluation time and has not expired
GitHub binds the emitted PASS 2 work immutably to the current semantic_generation_id, work_id, appid, exact dossier content sha256, and current Dossier compatibility binding
false_if_any: dossier only exists as an unaccepted buffered candidate
wrong work title or release identity
old or mismatched Dossier compatibility binding
current semantic_generation_id or work_id differs from the incomplete PASS 1 state
the automatic PASS 2 attempt budget for the current semantic_generation_id/work_id is already consumed

dossier_ready_transition.acceptance_event: canonical GitHub Dossier persistence/acceptance becomes an input to GitHub PASS 2 eligibility projection
dossier_ready_transition.automatic_effect: GitHub re-evaluates pending analysis_incomplete items and may add only the exact matching current semantic_generation_id/work_id item to future PASS 2 work

attempt_budget.terminal_unresolved_behavior: remain analysis_incomplete, remain visible in Tier 2, and leave automatic PASS 2 eligibility for that semantic_generation_id/work_id after the single automatic attempt is consumed
attempt_budget.attempt_consumption_rule: The future PASS 2 implementation must let GitHub consume the one automatic attempt only from an exact-bound accepted PASS 2 result or an explicit GitHub-owned terminal execution receipt proving that the authorized eligible attempt actually ran; mere Dossier waiting, eligibility, enqueueing, stale work, or unbound artifacts consume zero.

dossier_contract_dependencies.rule: PASS 2 consumes only canonical accepted dossier truth and does not redefine Dossier evidence, identity, freshness, or compatibility semantics.

phase_c_pass2_design.activation_guard: No PASS 2 runtime, scheduler, worker prompt, queue processor, or production execution is authorized by this design block. A separate implementation task must create and validate the GitHub-owned runtime path.
